AVOCADOMINI / CROWDFUNDING CONCEPT

From concept
to prototype.

avocadoMini keeps the owner-confirmed form shown here: four Motion Towers surrounding one central Mini200 E2 unit. Funding, payments, and early reservations have not started.

01 / FIRST MILESTONE

Validate the complete form with a prototype.

  1. Bench-test the telescoping mechanism, deployable feet, dock detection, and safety stop.
  2. Integrate four sensor streams with the central Mini200 E2 compute, storage, audio, and RockstarOS services.
  3. Measure body-to-display latency, local voice behavior, cooling, acoustics, and recovery on real hardware.

02 / PRICE

Current planned base price for the complete system (before tax): ¥410,000

This is the current plan for four towers plus one central unit. Tax, shipping, delivery, final specifications, and sales terms are not yet finalized.

Funding has not started

The platform, target, rewards, and delivery terms are still undecided. No support payment is collected on this page.
